critique: The charcoal squid, red-ochre fins, negative hand stencil firing chalk pebbles, and five-mark tally cleverly translate an autonomous shooter into a spare, recognisable cave-painting vocabulary. The soft radial hand “spray,” smooth gradient ground, and unrelated cartoon guinea-pig footer feel digitally polished rather than abraded into stone; harsher pigment edges and granular pitting would make the prehistoric conceit more convincing.
